IIT alumnus Advait Upadhyay has been missing since August 7 after he went on a solo trek at Shivagange, near Bengaluru.

According to reports, Advait, a 31-year-old cybersecurity professional, had travelled to the hill for the trek.

His motorcycle was found near the foothills, raising concerns after he could not be contacted.

Police, SDRF, forest officials and other rescue teams have been involved in the search operation across the difficult terrain.

A drone reportedly spotted a suspected body near Shantala Drop, but authorities are yet to officially confirm the identity.

🙏 We hope Advait is found safe. Our thoughts are with his family and friends during this difficult time.

MNNIT Allahabad students continue to raise their voice following the serious allegations involving an Assistant Professor.

Students are standing together and demanding justice, transparency, and a fair investigation into the matter.

The police have registered a case and arrested the accused professor, while the investigation and legal proceedings continue.

Students say they will not remain silent and will continue to stand with the student and support her pursuit of justice. 🤍✊

Every student deserves a safe campus, dignity, and the courage to speak up without fear.

⚖️ Let the investigation be fair. Let the truth come out. Let justice prevail.

The allegations remain subject to investigation and court proceedings.
